## Hello HTML
Create `index.html`:

```html
<!doctype html>
<html>
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Hello</title>
    <style>
      body { font-family: system-ui; }
      .greet { color: #4f46e5; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <h1 class="greet">Hello, HTML & CSS!</h1>
  </body>
</html>
```

Open in a browser to view the page.
